# experimental-marks

## Plugin reference

- Description: The Show experimental marks setting (view-options popover and Settings → Config, on an experimental build): useShowExperimentalMarks() is true when the build stamped this document experimental and the marks are on; the frame and the Wish banner both follow it. Registers the Show experimental marks config and, while it is off, serves a head script that hides the marks before the first frame.
